node.statement: For row p_i of P, write p_i=p_i^+-p_i^- with disjoint nonnegative positive and negative parts, let a_i=sum_k (P_{ik})_- <= delta, and set q_i=p_i^+/(1+a_i). Since sum_k p_{ik}=1 by def-signed-idempotent, sum_k p_i^+=1+a_i, so each q_i is nonnegative of total mass 1 and Q is row-stochastic by def-stochastic.
